searchText: applied for a talk on FOCIL specifically but a panel (and other talks on ILs) would be nice in any case! which track did you apply? I was pondering on giving a talk on the general tradeoffs in any abstract system with examples from the known ones. But somehow a pannel of CR in general seems more useful, specially for a track like Cypherpunks... haven't really made up my mind about the topic yet I naively applied to core protocol track but yeah a panel on CR in the cypherpunks track sounds nice 🙂 will try to think of ideas as well I originally assumed you might give a talk on synergies and potential tradeoffs between epbs and ILs? I did apply for an ePBS talk at core track, for ILs I was thinking on more generic terms, even without ePBS, the tradeoffs of not knowing statically the validity of the IL is not light, so I'm trying to think of systems that actually work for that I'll be interested in a panel if there's room for it. I haven't applied to any talk. Just thinking about doing panels this time : )
